metadata.title: AI Pretraining From Scratch - Sources
metadata.description: Primary sources for building transformer/GPT and BPE tokenizer from first principles: Karpathy Zero-to-Hero series, nanoGPT, nanochat, minbpe, Raschka LLMs-from-scratch, foundational papers, modern-architecture papers (RoPE/RMSNorm/SwiGLU/GQA/FlashAttention), the modded-nanoGPT/Muon speedrun frontier, production Muon reports (Kimi K2 MuonClip, DeepSeek-V4, GLM-5), and PyTorch mixed-precision docs.

foundational_papers.name: Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani et al. 2017)
foundational_papers.relevance: Original transformer architecture: scaled dot-product attention, multi-head attention, positional encoding, encoder-decoder stack.

foundational_papers.name: Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners (GPT-2, Radford et al. 2019)
foundational_papers.relevance: GPT-2 architecture details: pre-norm placement, weight tying, byte-level BPE tokenizer design, hyperparameters for 124M model.

foundational_papers.name: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners (GPT-3, Brown et al. 2020)
foundational_papers.relevance: GPT-3 training hyperparameters: cosine LR schedule, Adam betas, weight decay configuration, batch size ramp.

karpathy_zero_to_hero.name: Neural Networks: Zero to Hero — Full Playlist (Karpathy)
karpathy_zero_to_hero.relevance: Complete from-scratch curriculum: micrograd (autograd), makemore (character LMs), nanoGPT build, GPT tokenizer, GPT-2 reproduction.

karpathy_zero_to_hero.name: Let's build GPT: from scratch, in code, spelled out (Karpathy)
karpathy_zero_to_hero.relevance: Step-by-step transformer implementation: bigram baseline to multi-head attention to full GPT on Shakespeare.

karpathy_zero_to_hero.name: Let's reproduce GPT-2 (124M) (Karpathy)
karpathy_zero_to_hero.relevance: End-to-end GPT-2 reproduction: weight loading from HuggingFace, bf16 autocast, gradient accumulation, cosine LR, FineWeb-Edu training.

karpathy_zero_to_hero.name: Let's build the GPT Tokenizer (Karpathy)
karpathy_zero_to_hero.relevance: Byte-level BPE from scratch: merge algorithm, vocab construction, encode/decode, tiktoken comparison.

modern_architecture_papers.name: RoFormer: Rotary Position Embedding (Su et al. 2021)
modern_architecture_papers.relevance: RoPE — rotary positional embeddings applied to q/k inside attention. Replaces learned absolute position tables; encodes relative position and extrapolates to longer contexts. Standard in Llama/Mistral/Qwen/Gemma.

modern_architecture_papers.name: Root Mean Square Layer Normalization (Zhang & Sennrich 2019)
modern_architecture_papers.relevance: RMSNorm — drops mean-centering and bias from LayerNorm, rescaling by RMS only. Cheaper and stable at depth; the norm in modern decoder stacks.

modern_architecture_papers.name: GLU Variants Improve Transformer (Shazeer 2020)
modern_architecture_papers.relevance: SwiGLU — gated FFN (silu(gate(x)) * up(x)) that replaces the GELU-MLP. Hidden dim scaled to ~8/3*d to hold params constant. Quality gain per parameter.

modern_architecture_papers.name: GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models (Ainslie et al. 2023)
modern_architecture_papers.relevance: Grouped-query attention — fewer KV heads than query heads. Shrinks the KV cache with negligible quality loss; the MHA/MQA interpolation used in modern models.

modern_architecture_papers.name: FlashAttention-2 (Dao 2023)
modern_architecture_papers.relevance: IO-aware tiled attention kernel — O(T) memory instead of O(T^2). Backs PyTorch F.scaled_dot_product_attention. (FlashAttention v1: arxiv.org/abs/2205.14135.)

modern_architecture_papers.name: FlashAttention-3 (Shah et al. 2024)
modern_architecture_papers.relevance: Hopper-optimized attention: asynchrony, warp-specialization, FP8 (~1.6-2x over FA-2). The 2026 standard kernel SDPA/vLLM/SGLang dispatch to; FA-4 extends this to Blackwell.

modern_architecture_papers.name: Muon is Scalable for LLM Training (Moonshot AI, Feb 2025)
modern_architecture_papers.relevance: Weight-decay + per-parameter update-scale fixes that let Muon train at scale without bespoke tuning; the paper's own benchmark is the 3B/16B-active Moonlight MoE (~2x AdamW compute efficiency at that scale) — cite each later production model's own report for its recipe, not this paper directly.

modern_architecture_papers.name: FlashAttention-4: Algorithm and Kernel Pipelining Co-Design for Asymmetric Hardware Scaling (Dao et al., March 2026)
modern_architecture_papers.relevance: Blackwell (B200/GB200) attention kernel, ~20% over cuDNN's prior best. Confirmed real/shipped as of March 2026 — the current kernel SDPA dispatches to on Blackwell, mirroring FA-3 on Hopper.

modern_architecture_papers.name: Kimi K2 Technical Report (Moonshot AI, 2025)
modern_architecture_papers.relevance: Confirms MuonClip (Muon + QK-Clip attention-logit bound) at 1T-param scale, 15.5T tokens, no loss spikes. Verified production use of a Muon variant — cite this directly rather than the original Moonlight paper.

modern_architecture_papers.name: GLM-5 Technical Report: From Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering (Zhipu AI, Feb 2026)
modern_architecture_papers.relevance: ~745B-param MoE; documents a zero-redundant-communication distributed Muon implementation and an internal GQA-8 vs MLA ablation where GQA-8 won — evidence attention-scheme choice at the frontier has not converged on MLA.

reference_implementations.name: nanoGPT (Karpathy)
reference_implementations.relevance: Canonical minimal GPT implementation. Reference for model.py architecture, train.py loop, weight init, and GPT-2 weight loading.

reference_implementations.name: minbpe (Karpathy)
reference_implementations.relevance: Minimal BPE tokenizer implementation. Reference for BasicTokenizer, RegexTokenizer, GPT-4 pre-tokenization pattern.

reference_implementations.name: Build a Large Language Model From Scratch (Raschka, Manning 2024)
reference_implementations.relevance: End-to-end textbook: BPE tokenization, GPT architecture, pretraining loop, temperature/top-k sampling, loading GPT-2 weights, classification fine-tuning, instruction/SFT fine-tuning, LoRA. Pedagogical spine matches this skill through the pretraining chapters.

reference_implementations.name: LLMs-from-scratch (Raschka)
reference_implementations.relevance: Book companion code for 'Build a Large Language Model From Scratch'. Chapter-by-chapter GPT implementation with detailed explanations.

reference_implementations.name: nanochat (Karpathy)
reference_implementations.relevance: 2025 full-stack from-scratch successor to nanoGPT: tokenizer training, pretraining on FineWeb, midtraining, SFT, RL (GRPO), eval, and serving in ~8k lines. The current end-to-end 'from scratch' reference pipeline.

reference_implementations.name: modded-nanoGPT (Keller Jordan et al.)
reference_implementations.relevance: GPT-2 reproduction speedrun and Muon optimizer reference. Modern stack: Muon, rotary embeddings, QK-Norm, ReLU^2, logit softcap, zero-init projections, embedding-skip connections. Record wall-clock is a moving target — check the README.

pytorch_docs.name: PyTorch Automatic Mixed Precision (torch.autocast)
pytorch_docs.relevance: torch.autocast API, bfloat16 vs float16 guidance, GradScaler for fp16, device compatibility notes.

pytorch_docs.name: PyTorch Gradient Checkpointing (torch.utils.checkpoint)
pytorch_docs.relevance: Activation checkpointing API for trading memory for compute during backward pass.

architecture_limitations_and_workarounds.name: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report (2024)
architecture_limitations_and_workarounds.relevance: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) low-rank KV compression + decoupled RoPE; blockwise/group-128 FP8 training with FP32 accumulation; aux-loss-free MoE load balancing.

architecture_limitations_and_workarounds.name: YaRN: Efficient Context Window Extension of LLMs (Peng et al. 2023)
architecture_limitations_and_workarounds.relevance: RoPE context extension: frequency-band-wise interpolation + attention temperature; the strongest of linear-PI / NTK-aware / YaRN. Train-short-extend-long recipe.

architecture_limitations_and_workarounds.name: Efficient Streaming Language Models with Attention Sinks (Xiao et al. 2023)
architecture_limitations_and_workarounds.relevance: Attention-sink phenomenon and StreamingLLM: keep sink tokens + recent window for fixed-memory long streams; grounds softmax pathology and long-context workaround sections.

architecture_limitations_and_workarounds.name: Methods of Improving LLM Training Stability (Takase et al. 2024)
architecture_limitations_and_workarounds.relevance: QK-Norm, logit soft-capping, and init/normalization choices that bound attention-logit growth and prevent loss spikes at scale.

architecture_limitations_and_workarounds.name: Transformer Feed-Forward Layers Are Key-Value Memories (Geva et al. 2020)
architecture_limitations_and_workarounds.relevance: The key-value-memory view of the FFN: up-projection keys detect patterns, down-projection values write content — grounds the MLP/FFN knowledge-storage framing.

architecture_limitations_and_workarounds.name: ELECTRA: Pre-training Text Encoders as Discriminators (Clark et al. 2020)
architecture_limitations_and_workarounds.relevance: Replaced-token-detection fixes MLM's ~15%-token sample inefficiency; grounds the encoder-only limitation/workaround in the family contrast.

architecture_limitations_and_workarounds.name: The Evolution of Mixture-of-Experts Architectures in LLMs: Routing, Topology, Load Balancing, and Expert Parallelism (Li, 2026)
architecture_limitations_and_workarounds.relevance: Five-axis MoE taxonomy (expert granularity, expert topology, routing freedom, scope of load balancing, execution structure) used to structure the MoE design-space table in section 5.

architecture_limitations_and_workarounds.name: Tying the Loop: Tied Expert Layers in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models (Jaggi, 2026)
architecture_limitations_and_workarounds.relevance: Expert Tying shares expert parameters across consecutive transformer layers while keeping per-layer routing, cutting MoE memory ~2x; the topology-axis example in section 5.

adaptive_depth_and_conditional_compute.name: Mixture-of-Depths: Dynamically allocating compute in transformer-based language models
adaptive_depth_and_conditional_compute.relevance: Defines top-k per-block token routing with a fixed capacity, the origin of the depth-axis conditional-compute vocabulary.

adaptive_depth_and_conditional_compute.name: LayerSkip: Enabling Early Exit Inference and Self-Speculative Decoding
adaptive_depth_and_conditional_compute.relevance: Layer-dropout plus early-exit-loss training recipe that makes early exit accurate, with self-speculative decoding for lossless speedup.

adaptive_depth_and_conditional_compute.name: TIDE: Token-Informed Depth Execution for Per-Token Early Exit in LLM Inference
adaptive_depth_and_conditional_compute.relevance: Post-training per-token early exit via tiny routers at checkpoint layers, requiring no retraining of the base model.

adaptive_depth_and_conditional_compute.name: Universal Transformers
adaptive_depth_and_conditional_compute.relevance: Ancestor of looped transformers: recurrence in depth with an Adaptive Computation Time halting mechanism.

adaptive_depth_and_conditional_compute.name: ALBERT: A Lite BERT for Self-supervised Learning of Language Representations
adaptive_depth_and_conditional_compute.relevance: Cross-layer parameter sharing as a parameter-reduction technique, the cleanest early demonstration that depth-sharing costs little quality.

adaptive_depth_and_conditional_compute.name: Mixture-of-Recursions: Learning Dynamic Recursive Depths for Adaptive Token-Level Computation
adaptive_depth_and_conditional_compute.relevance: NeurIPS 2025 synthesis unifying parameter sharing and adaptive token-level depth, with KV caching restricted to still-active tokens.

adaptive_depth_and_conditional_compute.name: AdaPonderLM: Gated Pondering Language Models with Token-Wise Adaptive Depth
adaptive_depth_and_conditional_compute.relevance: Monotonic halting mask plus KV reuse for halted tokens; shows learned halting beats fixed pruning under iso-FLOPs.

adaptive_depth_and_conditional_compute.name: Depth-adaptive Inference of Looped Language Models via Continuous Depth Batching
adaptive_depth_and_conditional_compute.relevance: First end-to-end loop-level scheduler, showing the serving stack is part of the adaptive-depth architecture decision.

adaptive_depth_and_conditional_compute.name: Do Language Models Use Their Depth Efficiently?
adaptive_depth_and_conditional_compute.relevance: NeurIPS 2025 residual-stream analysis finding second-half layers contribute much less, motivating where depth slack exists.

adaptive_depth_and_conditional_compute.name: Modular Deep Learning
adaptive_depth_and_conditional_compute.relevance: Survey framing MoE, MoD, looped nets, and adapters as one modules-plus-routing design space.

structured_and_low_rank_parameterization.name: Monarch: Expressive Structured Matrices for Efficient and Accurate Training
structured_and_low_rank_parameterization.relevance: Defines Monarch as products of block-diagonal matrices with an analytical optimal dense-projection, the hardware-friendly answer to butterfly matrices.

structured_and_low_rank_parameterization.name: BLAST: Block-Level Adaptive Structured Matrices for Efficient Deep Neural Network Inference
structured_and_low_rank_parameterization.relevance: Block-level adaptive structure that learns which structural family fits, usable both as a training parameterization and as a compression target.

structured_and_low_rank_parameterization.name: Building on Efficient Foundations: Effectively Training LLMs with Structured Feedforward Layers
structured_and_low_rank_parameterization.relevance: The from-scratch training study for structured FFNs up to 1.3B params, source of the self-guided training regime and the FLOP-scaling argument.

structured_and_low_rank_parameterization.name: SVD-LLM: Truncation-aware Singular Value Decomposition for Large Language Model Compression
structured_and_low_rank_parameterization.relevance: Truncation-aware data whitening plus a sequential low-rank parameter update, explaining why naive SVD truncation minimizes the wrong error.

structured_and_low_rank_parameterization.name: ASVD: Activation-aware Singular Value Decomposition for Compressing Large Language Models
structured_and_low_rank_parameterization.relevance: Training-free activation-aware weight transform with per-layer iterative calibration, the basis for the non-uniform-rank guidance.

structured_and_low_rank_parameterization.name: Memory-Efficient Acceleration of Block Low-Rank Foundation Models on Resource Constrained GPUs
structured_and_low_rank_parameterization.relevance: Roofline evidence that block low-rank multi-token inference is memory-bound in PyTorch, and the Triton-kernel fix — the FLOPs-vs-wall-clock warning.

structured_and_low_rank_parameterization.name: DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model
structured_and_low_rank_parameterization.relevance: MLA as the same low-rank factorization applied to the KV path, designed in rather than imposed post-hoc.

expert_panel_aug_2026.name: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
expert_panel_aug_2026.relevance: Origin of the top-k/top-1 MoE router and the auxiliary load-balancing loss L_aux = alpha * N * sum_i f_i * P_i cited in section 5 of architecture-limitations-and-workarounds.md.

expert_panel_aug_2026.name: Auxiliary-Loss-Free Load Balancing Strategy for Mixture-of-Experts
expert_panel_aug_2026.relevance: Bias-based load balancing (expert-wise bias on routing scores, selection only) adopted by DeepSeek-V3; the alternative to the auxiliary loss in the section 5 MoE failure-mode table.

expert_panel_aug_2026.name: Toy Models of Superposition — Elhage et al., Anthropic Transformer Circuits Thread (2022)
expert_panel_aug_2026.relevance: Mechanism for why pretrained weight spectra are approximately full-rank: features are stored in overlapping non-orthogonal directions (superposition), so there is no small subspace to truncate. Explains why low-rank truncation of W degrades quality while low-rank updates do not.

expert_panel_aug_2026.name: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models — Hu, Shen, Wallis, Allen-Zhu, Li, Wang, Wang, Chen
expert_panel_aug_2026.relevance: The adaptation counterpart to low-rank compression: freezes dense W and learns a low-rank update. Cited in the structured-parameterization reference to separate constraining the update from compressing the weight; abstract reports an empirical investigation into rank-deficiency in language model adaptation.

tokenization.name: SuperBPE: Space Travel for Language Models (arXiv 2503.13423)
tokenization.relevance: Superword tokenization crossing whitespace boundaries. Abstract verified 2026-09-08: 'up to 33% fewer tokens than BPE on average' at fixed 200k vocab, '+4.0% absolute improvement over the BPE baseline across 30 downstream tasks (including +8.2% on MMLU)', 27% less inference compute.

tokenization.name: Over-Tokenized Transformer (arXiv 2501.16975)
tokenization.relevance: Argues vocabulary is generally worth scaling with model size — backs the vocab-size guidance in bpe-tokenizer.md. Direction cited; magnitudes not quoted (abstract not independently re-read).

tokenization.name: LiteToken: Removing Intermediate Merge Residues From BPE Tokenizers (arXiv 2602.04706)
tokenization.relevance: ~10% of tokens in major BPE tokenizers are intermediate merge residues rarely emitted in output — dead embedding rows. Cited for the tokenizer-audit step; verify body before quoting further figures.

tokenization.name: UTF-8 Plumbing: byte-level tokenizers enable ill-formed UTF-8 output (arXiv 2511.05578)
tokenization.relevance: Byte-level models can emit invalid UTF-8 — the gotcha behind requiring downstream validation rather than errors='replace' alone.

tokenization.name: SentencePiece (Google)
tokenization.relevance: The BPE/Unigram training framework behind most open multilingual tokenizers; no pre-tokenization, space as U+2581 metasymbol, lossless round-trip. The Unigram-LM implementation referenced in the tokenizer landscape table.
